create_adsorbate_slab_config: create an AdsorbateSlabConfig object to generate adsorbate-catalyst systems for a given slab and adsorbate
get_binding_sites: get binding sites on a slab surface using random Delaunay triangulation or heuristic site finding
place_adsorbate_on_site: place an adsorbate molecule at a specific binding site on a slab surface with rotation
check_atomic_overlap: check if there is atomic overlap between surface atoms and adsorbate atoms in a configuration
get_interstitial_distances: get the interstitial distances between all surface and adsorbate atom pairs in a configuration
